timing: Written after one planned-connected heterogeneous replicate was used only to verify MML/CMLE call feasibility and runtime, and before producing the bridge bundle. No recovery result from that feasibility call is an input to a gate.
purpose: Pass identical rank-full PCM-generated rows through FACETS JMLE, Python JMLE, Python MML, and native exact CMLE while preserving their different estimands and likelihood bases.

input_scope.excluded_negative_control: All disconnected runs remain in the parent attempt ledger but are excluded from estimator recovery and model-selection claims because nullity=1.

new_mml_modes.PYTHON_MML_FIXED_SD1_Q31: Normal Person population with SD fixed at 1.0; a sensitivity condition, not asserted to equal the realized generator SD.
new_mml_modes.PYTHON_MML_FREE_SD_Q31: Normal Person population with SD estimated from the responses.

fit_matrix.new_cmle_mode: PYTHON_EXACT_CMLE; Person parameters removed by conditioning on Person totals.

estimand_contract.facets_python_jmle: Same fixed-Person joint-likelihood estimand; direct engine equality is meaningful only here.
estimand_contract.mml: Marginal likelihood under a normal Person population. Differences from JMLE or CMLE are estimand/assumption sensitivity, not engine error.
estimand_contract.cmle: Exact conditional likelihood given each Person total. Conditional log-likelihood/AIC are compared only between RSM and PCM within CMLE, never numerically against JMLE/MML likelihood/AIC.
estimand_contract.truth_alignment: Unanchored Rater, Task, and Criterion estimates are mean-aligned within facet before truth error is computed.
estimand_contract.threshold_truth: PCM thresholds have criterion-specific truth in both conditions; RSM thresholds have a truth target only in the shared condition. RSM heterogeneous thresholds are pseudo-true and truth error is undefined.

locked_operational_gates.input_identity: All selected rows and truth tables must hash to the retained parent files; no data are regenerated.
locked_operational_gates.parent_jmle: All 16 selected parent run-model JMLE contracts must remain comparison eligible.
locked_operational_gates.mml: All 32 MML attempts must return, converge, be InferenceReady, contain finite main-facet/threshold estimates, and satisfy the fitted facet and threshold constraints. Free population SD must be finite and positive.
locked_operational_gates.cmle: All 16 CMLE audits and fits must be conditionally rank-full, converge, be InferenceReady, pass the finite-MLE existence gate, contain finite structural estimates/SEs, and satisfy constraints.
locked_operational_gates.model_direction: For each design, replicate, and likelihood mode with a matched likelihood basis, the PCM-over-RSM log-likelihood gain per observation must be greater under heterogeneous than shared thresholds. JMLE, fixed-SD MML, free-SD MML, and CMLE are evaluated separately.

descriptive_outputs: Truth RMSE and signed error by estimator, response model, design, condition, and facet.
Criterion-specific or common threshold recovery where a data-generating truth target exists.
Pairwise estimate shifts relative to Python JMLE, labelled different_estimand except for FACETS JMLE.
Estimated Person population SD for free-SD MML.
Within-estimator RSM-versus-PCM likelihood/AIC direction using only matched likelihood bases.
withheld_claims: No estimator winner or ranking from two replicates.
No bias, RMSE ordering, coverage, false-positive, power, or model-selection error-rate claim.
No comparison of CMLE conditional AIC/log-likelihood values to JMLE or MML AIC/log-likelihood values.
No inference from structurally disconnected parent runs.
No automatic estimator recommendation in the Streamlit UI.
